scripts.build: bun scripts/bun-run.js rollup --config --configType full --configType fullMin --configType fullEsm --configType fullEsmMin --configType light --configType lightMin --configType lightEsm --configType lightEsmMin --configType worker && bun run build:types
scripts.build:ci: bun scripts/bun-run.js rollup --config --configType full --configType fullMin --configType fullEsm --configType fullEsmMin --configType light --configType lightMin --configType lightEsm --configType lightEsmMin --configType worker && bun run build:types
scripts.build:types: bun scripts/bun-run.js tsc --build tsconfig-lib.json && bun scripts/bun-run.js api run --local && bun run build:copy-types
scripts.docs: bun scripts/bun-run.js doctoc ./docs/API.md && bun scripts/bun-run.js apiDocumenter markdown -i api-extractor -o api-extractor/api-documenter && bun -e "await Bun.file('api-extractor/api-documenter/index.md').delete()" && bun run docs-md-to-html
scripts.docs-md-to-html: bun scripts/bun-run.js generateMd --layout github --input api-extractor/api-documenter --output api-docs
scripts.sanity-check: bun run lint && bun run prettier:verify && bun run type-check && bun run build && bun scripts/bun-run.js esCheck && bun run docs && bun run test:unit
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:func
scripts.test:func:android: BROWSERSTACK=1 UA=chrome DEVICE='Samsung Galaxy S24' OS='Android 14' BABEL_ENV=development bun scripts/bun-run.js mocha --require @babel/register tests/functional/auto/setup.js --timeout 40000 --exit
scripts.test:func:android:tablet: BROWSERSTACK=1 UA=chrome DEVICE='Samsung Galaxy Tab S9' OS='Android 13' BABEL_ENV=development bun scripts/bun-run.js mocha --require @babel/register tests/functional/auto/setup.js --timeout 40000 --exit
scripts.test:func:browserstack: BROWSERSTACK=1 UA=safari OS='macOS 15' BABEL_ENV=development bun scripts/bun-run.js mocha --require @babel/register tests/functional/auto/setup.js --timeout 40000 --exit
scripts.test:func:ios: BROWSERSTACK=1 UA=safari DEVICE='iPhone 16' OS='iOS 18' BABEL_ENV=development bun scripts/bun-run.js mocha --require @babel/register tests/functional/auto/setup.js --timeout 40000 --exit
scripts.test:func:ipad: BROWSERSTACK=1 UA=safari DEVICE='iPad Pro 12.9 2022' OS='iOS 16' BABEL_ENV=development bun scripts/bun-run.js mocha --require @babel/register tests/functional/auto/setup.js --timeout 40000 --exit
scripts.test:func:light: BABEL_ENV=development HLSJS_LIGHT=1 bun scripts/bun-run.js mocha --require @babel/register tests/functional/auto/setup.js --timeout 40000 --exit
scripts.test:func:sauce: SAUCE=1 UA=safari OS='OS X 10.15' BABEL_ENV=development bun scripts/bun-run.js mocha --require @babel/register tests/functional/auto/setup.js --timeout 40000 --exit
scripts.test:unit:debug: DEBUG_UNIT_TESTS=1 bun scripts/bun-run.js karma start karma.conf.js --auto-watch --no-single-run --browsers Chrome
